passages.text: But understand this: In the last days terrible times will come.
passages.sermon:
Paul speaks to Timothy.
Paul warns Timothy.
Paul says, "Understand this."
In the last days, terrible times will come.
passages.original: Τοῦτο δὲ γίνωσκε ὅτι ἐν ἐσχάταις ἡμέραις ἐνστήσονται καιροὶ χαλεποί

passages.text: For men will be lovers of themselves, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, abusive, disobedient to their parents, ungrateful, unholy, unloving, unforgiving, slanderous, without self-control, brutal, without love of good, traitorous, reckless, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God, having a form of godliness but denying its power. Turn away from such as these!
passages.sermon:
In the last days, people will act in evil ways.
People will love themselves.
People will love money.
People will boast.
People will be proud.
People will speak evil words.
People will disobey their parents.
People will be ungrateful.
People will be unholy.
People will not love others.
People will not forgive.
People will slander others.
People will lack self-control.
People will be brutal.
People will not love what is good.
People will betray others.
People will act recklessly.
People will be conceited.
People will love pleasure more than they love God.
People will pretend to be godly.
People will deny the true power of godliness.
You must turn away from these people.
passages.original: ἔσονται γὰρ οἱ ἄνθρωποι φίλαυτοι φιλάργυροι ἀλαζόνες ὑπερήφανοι βλάσφημοι γονεῦσιν ἀπειθεῖς ἀχάριστοι ἀνόσιοι ἄστοργοι ἄσπονδοι διάβολοι ἀκρατεῖς ἀνήμεροι ἀφιλάγαθοι προδόται προπετεῖς τετυφωμένοι φιλήδονοι μᾶλλον ἢ φιλόθεοι ἔχοντες μόρφωσιν εὐσεβείας τὴν δὲ δύναμιν αὐτῆς ἠρνημένοι καὶ τούτους ἀποτρέπου

passages.text: They are the kind who worm their way into households and captivate vulnerable women who are weighed down with sins and led astray by various passions, who are always learning but never able to come to a knowledge of the truth.
passages.sermon:
Certain men act in evil ways.
These men enter into households.
They gain control over weak women.
These women carry many sins.
Various desires lead these women astray.
These women always try to learn.
They never reach the knowledge of the truth.
passages.original: Ἐκ τούτων γάρ εἰσιν οἱ ἐνδύνοντες εἰς τὰς οἰκίας καὶ αἰχμαλωτίζοντες γυναικάρια σεσωρευμένα ἁμαρτίαις ἀγόμενα ἐπιθυμίαις ποικίλαις πάντοτε μανθάνοντα καὶ μηδέποτε εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν ἀληθείας ἐλθεῖν δυνάμενα

passages.text: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so also these men oppose the truth. They are depraved in mind and disqualified from the faith.
passages.sermon:
Jannes and Jambres were men who opposed Moses.
These men were against God’s servant.
In the same way, these men now oppose the truth.
They fight against what is right.
Their minds are corrupt.
They are not fit for the faith.
passages.original: ὃν τρόπον δὲ Ἰάννης καὶ Ἰαμβρῆς ἀντέστησαν Μωϋσεῖ οὕτως καὶ οὗτοι ἀνθίστανται τῇ ἀληθείᾳ ἄνθρωποι κατεφθαρμένοι τὸν νοῦν ἀδόκιμοι περὶ τὴν πίστιν

passages.text: But they will not advance much further. For just like Jannes and Jambres, their folly will be plain to everyone.
passages.sermon:
These men oppose the truth.
They are depraved in mind.
They are disqualified from the faith.
But they will not succeed much longer.
Everyone will see their foolishness.
Their folly will become obvious to all.
This happened to Jannes and Jambres also.
passages.original: ἀλλ’ οὐ προκόψουσιν ἐπὶ πλεῖον ἡ γὰρ ἄνοια αὐτῶν ἔκδηλος ἔσται πᾶσιν ὡς καὶ ἡ ἐκείνων ἐγένετο

passages.text: You, however, have observed my teaching, my conduct, my purpose, my faith, my patience, my love, my perseverance, my persecutions, and the sufferings that came upon me in Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. What persecutions I endured! Yet the Lord rescued me from all of them.
passages.sermon:
You have watched my life closely.
You have seen my teaching.
You have seen how I live.
You have seen my purpose.
You have seen my faith.
You have seen my patience.
You have seen my love.
You have seen my perseverance.
You have seen my persecutions.
You have seen my sufferings.
These things happened to me in Antioch.
They happened in Iconium.
They happened in Lystra.
I endured many persecutions.
The Lord rescued me from all of them.
passages.original: Σὺ δὲ παρηκολούθησάς μου τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ τῇ ἀγωγῇ τῇ προθέσει τῇ πίστει τῇ μακροθυμίᾳ τῇ ἀγάπῃ τῇ ὑπομονῇ τοῖς διωγμοῖς τοῖς παθήμασιν οἷά μοι ἐγένετο ἐν Ἀντιοχείᾳ ἐν Ἰκονίῳ ἐν Λύστροις οἵους διωγμοὺς ὑπήνεγκα καὶ ἐκ πάντων με ἐρρύσατο ὁ Κύριος

passages.text: Indeed, all who desire to live godly lives in Christ Jesus will be persecuted, while evil men and imposters go from bad to worse, deceiving and being deceived.
passages.sermon:
All people who want to live a godly life in Christ Jesus will face persecution.
Evil people will become worse.
Imposters will also become worse.
They will deceive others.
They themselves will be deceived.
passages.original: καὶ πάντες δὲ οἱ θέλοντες ζῆν εὐσεβῶς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ διωχθήσονται πονηροὶ δὲ ἄνθρωποι καὶ γόητες προκόψουσιν ἐπὶ τὸ χεῖρον πλανῶντες καὶ πλανώμενοι

passages.text: But as for you, continue in the things you have learned and firmly believed, since you know from whom you have learned them.
passages.sermon:
You have learned many things.
You have become convinced of these things.
You know who taught you these things.
Continue in what you have learned and believed.
passages.original: Σὺ δὲ μένε ἐν οἷς ἔμαθες καὶ ἐπιστώθης εἰδὼς παρὰ τίνων ἔμαθες

passages.text: From infancy you have known the Holy Scriptures, which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.
passages.sermon:
Timothy, you have known the Holy Scriptures since you were a child.
These Scriptures can make you wise.
They lead you to salvation.
You receive this salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.
passages.original: καὶ ὅτι ἀπὸ βρέφους τὰ ἱερὰ γράμματα οἶδας τὰ δυνάμενά σε σοφίσαι εἰς σωτηρίαν διὰ πίστεως τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ

passages.text: All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for instruction, for conviction, for correction, and for training in righteousness, so that the man of God may be complete, fully equipped for every good work.
passages.sermon:
All Scripture comes from God.
All Scripture is useful.
Scripture teaches people.
Scripture shows people their wrongs.
Scripture corrects people.
Scripture trains people to live righteously.
Scripture prepares the man of God.
The man of God becomes complete.
The man of God is ready for every good work.
passages.original: πᾶσα γραφὴ θεόπνευστος καὶ ὠφέλιμος πρὸς διδασκαλίαν πρὸς ἐλεγμόν πρὸς ἐπανόρθωσιν πρὸς παιδείαν τὴν ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ ἵνα ἄρτιος ᾖ ὁ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἄνθρωπος πρὸς πᾶν ἔργον ἀγαθὸν ἐξηρτισμένος
